verdict.rationale: Neon's AI-use security page says its SQL Editor AI features share only the database schema with the LLM (Amazon Bedrock), with no actual data shared. Its chat assistance draws on public sources without ingesting PII. This limits data exposure to AI but never addresses model training or gives users a control to prevent it. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training-on-customer-data commitment, a user-facing opt-out or toggle for the AI features, a statement that the schema shared with Bedrock is not used for training, and independent corroboration.
